basic_info.description: Stunning top floor flat with brand new features such as a remodeled kitchen, wide plank oak floors and new windows. Open, spacious floor plan, soaring 11' ceilings and petite deck off the master bedroom. In-unit W/D. With the new windows and being on an Oak downslope the property is surprisingly peaceful. Near all the resturants, shopping and amenities of the Hayes Valley commercial corridor. In a two-unit building for fast track condo conversion (buyer to verify) and Sirkin TIC agreement provided as a courtesy. 479 Oak also for sale.
